simple.meaning: יְמִימָה (Yᵉmîymâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jemimah , one of Job's daughters.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H3224. Yemimah יְמִימָה proper name, feminine (compare perhaps Arabic dove , noun of individual meaning of Frey) — daughter of Job Job 42:14 .
